It isn't an option, the exhibit says no shift bookings exist, and option b holds either way. Option d: the technical requirement keeps the queue open, and per-person shifts can't be a queue schedule. rationale: Re-review of the revised text. The first-pass finding is resolved and the Yes answer stands. The solution now ends 'and publish the agent', so a careful learner no longer has an omission to read as the catch. Correction to my first pass: I wrote that Microsoft says this step is required, which overstated it. The publish page gives a general rule for Copilot Studio agents, under a note scoping the article to the standard harness, and the extensibility article doesn't mention publishing. Neither says outright that the managed Customer Service Copilot Bot must be published. The new evidence note says the rule is applied by inference, and that's accurate. The extensibility article calls this bot a managed Copilot Studio agent, and its limitations list doesn't exempt publishing. The Customer Knowledge Management Agent setup also has a Copilot Studio Publish step, which fits that reading. The explanation's sentence that publishing is needed states the same inference plainly. I accept it because it's Microsoft's general rule, nothing contradicts it, and the Yes answer no longer depends on it. Unchanged from the first pass: the help pane not being a named authentication host doesn't hold up as a reason for No, because the Copilot Studio page says 'such as', the extensibility article names SharePoint for this agent, and the help pane table says Yes. Preview status is stated and accepted. The word publish now appears in the two Yes items of this series, but it isn't a tell: the items are delivered one at a time, and accepted Series A uses it on both a Yes and a No.

rationale: Stands, and the author's weak point 4 holds. This isn't a rejection from silence, which is what checks 5 and 9 guard against. A library of PDF files isn't a record type, and the solution's 'as its source' can't be configured. I also searched learn.microsoft.com, including release plans, for this agent reading SharePoint or files and found nothing.
